questions.stem_text: What was the significance of the Gulf of Tonkin resolution?

options.A: It allowed the US to intensify its involvement in Vietnam
options.B: It illustrated the influence of public opinion on US foreign policy
options.C: It enhanced Congressional control over the Vietnam War
options.D: It curtailed US involvement in Vietnam

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - It allowed the US to intensify its involvement in Vietnam

questions.stem_text: The Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty was the first accord

options.A: on nuclear weapons signed between the United States and the Soviet Union.
options.C: to be rejected by the U.S. Senate.
options.D: mandating the elimination of many long-range nuclear missiles.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - mandating the elimination of many long-range nuclear missiles.

questions.stem_text:
What did Charles Krauthammer mean by a 'unipolar moment' when describing the post-Cold War
system?

options.A: The chance for the United States to share power with other countries in the world
options.B: An opportunity to use to collapse of the Soviet Union to extend US power
options.C: An international system that didn't face any threats
options.D: The never-ending domination of the United States

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - An opportunity to use to collapse of the Soviet Union to extend US power
